name: Mission Split — Ironvale
html:
About

Ironvale helps organizations secure and manage access to their resources in a world where people work from anywhere.

We're hiring, view our openings →

We started building Ironvale in 2020 to solve a problem every company faces: securing remote access. Nearly every other piece of technology evolved over the preceding fifteen years and moved to the cloud — yet remote access was still overwhelmingly provided by a model that has been largely unchanged since the 1990s. We found the reason for this was that complex migration paths and a lack of ease of use were intimidating barriers to adopting a better, more secure approach.

At Ironvale, we understand that great security solutions also require a focus on usability, maintainability, and reliability. We deliver enterprise-grade service with consumer-grade usability, whether you are an administrator who lives and breathes information security or an end user who just wants to get on with your job, wherever you may be.

name: Security Features — Latchkey
html:
Security isn't a feature. It's our foundation.

Latchkey gives you, your family, and your organization's data the protection it deserves. Our two-key derivation model combines your account password and a machine-generated Secret Key, and Watchtower flags compromised passwords so you can act fast.

  • Absolutely infeasible to crack

    Latchkey's two-key derivation combines an account password with a 128-bit Secret Key, so even a breach of our servers can't decrypt anyone's vault.

  • Zero-knowledge architecture

    Our security starts with AES-256 end-to-end encryption, so your information stays inaccessible to everyone else — including us.

  • Industry-vetted security model

    We rely on independent security experts to test our encryption, and run the largest bug bounty program among password managers.

  • Active threat detection

    Latchkey Watchtower scans for breaches, reused passwords, and vulnerable sites, and alerts you the moment something needs your attention.

  • Compliance built in

    Data residency options, audit logs, and SOC 2 controls help your organization align with the mandates your customers expect.

  • Best-in-class support

    Our team answers directly, day or night, so a locked-out teammate or a lost device never turns into a lost afternoon.
